# Holon

> Open-source, local-first Rust workbench for always-on AI agents — explicit work items (`WorkItem`), event-driven wait/wake (`WaitFor`), linked `git worktree` isolation, and explicit origin/trust boundaries.

 Every page on `https://holon.run` supports native Markdown negotiation (`Accept: text/markdown`) as well as direct `.md` routes. Full-text search is available at `https://holon.run/api/search?q=<query>`.

## Getting Started

- [Home & Overview](https://holon.run/README.md): Product overview, quickstart commands, and client downloads.
- [Quickstart](https://holon.run/getting-started/README.md): Fastest path from installation to a running local agent.
- [Create Your First Agent](https://holon.run/getting-started/first-agent.md): Install Holon, configure a provider, start the daemon, and verify a named agent.
- [Onboarding Guide](https://holon.run/getting-started/onboarding.md): Interactive credential, model, and search setup with `holon onboard`.

## Core Concepts

- [Runtime Model](https://holon.run/concepts/runtime-model.md): How the daemon, clients, agents, work items, tasks, and workspaces fit together.
- [Work Items and Tasks](https://holon.run/concepts/work-items-and-tasks.md): Durable multi-turn objectives (`WorkItem`) vs. supervised execution handles (`Task`).
- [Events, Waits, and Wakeups](https://holon.run/concepts/events-and-waits.md): Zero-token suspension on `WaitFor` conditions and event-driven resumption.
- [Workspaces and Worktrees](https://holon.run/concepts/workspaces.md): Separating `agent_home` from project workspaces and isolating parallel edits with `git worktree`.
- [Trust Boundaries](https://holon.run/concepts/trust-boundaries.md): Separating operator authority, agent guidance, tool results, and untrusted external wakes.
- [Architecture Comparison](https://holon.run/concepts/architecture-comparison.md): Self-owned Rust agent runtime vs. CLI orchestration shells and hosted cloud bots.

## Key Guides

- [Run a Long-Lived Task](https://holon.run/guides/run-long-lived-task.md): Track progress across sessions and survive daemon restarts.
- [Build a Local PR Code Reviewer](https://holon.run/guides/build-code-reviewer.md): Continuous event-driven PR review with `code-reviewer`.
- [Connect External Events](https://holon.run/guides/connect-external-events.md): Webhook ingress and `wake_hint` verification.
- [Automate Holon over HTTP](https://holon.run/guides/automate-over-http.md): Submit and monitor work through the HTTP control plane.
- [Configure and Switch Models](https://holon.run/guides/configure-models.md): Local Ollama/vLLM setup, cloud providers, and failover chains.

## Authoritative Reference & Schemas

- [CLI Reference](https://holon.run/reference/cli.md): Verified `holon` command-line tree and flags.
- [Configuration Reference](https://holon.run/reference/configuration.md): `config.json` schema, credentials, and environment variables.
- [HTTP Control Plane](https://holon.run/reference/http-control-plane.md): REST endpoints, auth tokens, and SSE/payload contracts.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification](https://holon.run/reference/openapi.json): Machine-readable HTTP control plane OpenAPI schema.
- [Agent Templates Catalog (JSON)](https://holon.run/assets/agent-templates.json): Official pre-built role templates and skill references.
- [Supported Models](https://holon.run/reference/models.md): Built-in model and provider catalog.
